# PeerSpot

> PeerSpot is an enterprise technology review and comparison platform providing verified peer insights, ratings, and vendor comparisons across IT software, cloud services, security solutions, and infrastructure products.

PeerSpot aggregates reviews from verified IT professionals and enterprise buyers to help organizations make informed technology purchasing decisions. The platform specializes in detailed product comparisons, vendor analysis, and peer-driven ratings across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), security tools, databases, and infrastructure solutions.

## Key Topics

- AWS vs Azure
- Cloud Security
- Firewall Comparison
- Product Comparison
- Vendor Comparison
- Enterprise Security
- Cloud Platforms
- Container Orchestration
- SIEM Solutions
- API Management
- DevOps Platforms
- Virtualization
- Object Storage
- DNS Services
- Code Security

## Core Platform

- [PeerSpot Homepage](https://www.peerspot.com): PeerSpot homepage: enterprise technology reviews, ratings, and vendor comparisons
- [All Categories | IT Applications and Software](https://www.peerspot.com/categories): Browsable directory of IT software and application categories with reviews
